apis.description: A paginated list of the list of sections for this course.

operations.notes: A paginated list of the list of sections for this course.

parameters.name: course_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: include
parameters.description:
- "students": Associations to include with the group. Note: this is only
  available if you have permission to view users or grades in the course
- "avatar_url": Include the avatar URLs for students returned.
- "enrollments": If 'students' is also included, return the section
  enrollment for each student
- "total_students": Returns the total amount of active and invited students
  for the course section
- "passback_status": Include the grade passback status.
- "permissions": Include whether section grants :manage_calendar permission
  to the caller

parameters.name: search_term
parameters.description:
When included, searches course sections for the term. Returns only matching
results. Term must be at least 2 characters.

apis.description: Creates a new section for this course.

operations.notes: Creates a new section for this course.

parameters.name: course_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: course_section[name]
parameters.description: The name of the section

parameters.name: course_section[sis_section_id]
parameters.description: The sis ID of the section. Must have manage_sis permission to set. This is ignored if caller does not have permission to set.

parameters.name: course_section[integration_id]
parameters.description: The integration_id of the section. Must have manage_sis permission to set. This is ignored if caller does not have permission to set.

parameters.name: course_section[start_at]
parameters.description: Section start date in ISO8601 format, e.g. 2011-01-01T01:00Z

parameters.name: course_section[end_at]
parameters.description: Section end date in ISO8601 format. e.g. 2011-01-01T01:00Z

parameters.name: course_section[restrict_enrollments_to_section_dates]
parameters.description: Set to true to restrict user enrollments to the start and end dates of the section.

parameters.name: enable_sis_reactivation
parameters.description: When true, will first try to re-activate a deleted section with matching sis_section_id if possible.

apis.description: Returns a paginated list of users in the section.

operations.notes: Returns a paginated list of users in the section.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: search_term
parameters.description:
The partial name or full ID of the users to match and return in the
results list. Must be at least 2 characters.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: "avatar_url": Include users' avatar_urls.

parameters.name: exclude_inactive
parameters.description:
Whether to filter out inactive users from the results. Defaults to
false unless explicitly provided.

parameters.name: enrollment_type
parameters.description: When set, only return users with the specified enrollment type for the given section.

id.description: The unique identifier for the section.

sis_section_id.description: The sis id of the section. This field is only included if the user has permission to view SIS information.

integration_id.description: Optional: The integration ID of the section. This field is only included if the user has permission to view SIS information.

sis_import_id.description: The unique identifier for the SIS import if created through SIS. This field is only included if the user has permission to manage SIS information.

course_id.description: The unique Canvas identifier for the course in which the section belongs

sis_course_id.description: The unique SIS identifier for the course in which the section belongs. This field is only included if the user has permission to view SIS information.

start_at.description: the start date for the section, if applicable

end_at.description: the end date for the section, if applicable

restrict_enrollments_to_section_dates.description: Restrict user enrollments to the start and end dates of the section

nonxlist_course_id.description: The unique identifier of the original course of a cross-listed section

total_students.description: optional: the total number of active and invited students in the section

students.description: optional: A list of students that are included in the section. Returned only if include[]=students. WARNING: this collection's size is capped (if there are an extremely large number of users in the section (thousands) not all of them will be returned). If you need to capture all the users in a section with certainty or experiencing slow response consider using the paginated /api/v1/sections/<section_id>/users endpoint.
